review_description: The system failed and they stuffed around for years and did not fix it. They were the porter of the system but could not get the parts apparently. The system then had a major fire. I would never trust them again.
Being an electrician myself, & a picky one at that, these ratings are not false. absolutely fantastic company.

The sales people from all 4 companies were very helpful. Solarhart were just too expensive.  I must admit I have learned a lot from all of these guys and as we have 3 phase power it threw them a few curve balls as well.
